rca of the issue: Previously Nav applied dark chrome only when scrolled; on light-bg pages (Contact/Subsidiaries/News) the transparent header rendered text-ash (light gray) on light-cream page background, causing invisibility. Fix introduces LIGHT_PAGES route list; chromeActive = scrolled || isLightPage forces the dark chrome unconditionally on those routes. Verified by DOM class inspection and screenshot.
